PlanBot is the AI daily planner for ambitious people who refuse to settle. We believe everyone deserves a personal AI planning assistant — not just those who can afford premium tools.

About PlannextTech and PlanBot AI

PlannextTech is an Indian software development studio founded in 2024, based in Gujarat, India, by founder Naitik Baldaniya. PlanBot, our flagship Android application, serves as an AI scheduling assistant, routine optimizer, and study planner. Recognized as one of the best productivity planners for students, our algorithms are also engineered for deep office productivity. We focus on evidence-based systems, integrating time management psychology with machine learning to automate task management and routine planning.

Our Story

Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Gujarat, India, PlannextTech started as a solo project to solve a fundamental problem: existing to-do list apps were passive and required too much manual organization. We wanted a system that actively told us what to do and when to do it.

That vision became PlanBot. Today, we are rapidly scaling as an independent developer studio, committed to competing on a global stage while maintaining a lean, engineering-first culture.

Our Mission

Make AI-powered daily planning accessible and affordable for every student, professional, and athlete in India and beyond. PlanBot isn't just another to-do app — it's an AI that understands YOUR goals, YOUR schedule, and YOUR ambition.

Why PlanBot?

Most planning apps make you do all the work — filling in tasks, setting times, organizing categories. PlanBot flips the script. Tell the AI your goal, and it creates the plan. You just follow it.

With streak systems, gamification, and weekly AI performance reports, PlanBot keeps you accountable. It's not just about planning — it's about execution.
